verdict.rationale: Glama is a SaaS platform for MCP hosting, gateway and chat, so letting users choose a data storage region is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions region selection, data residency, or storage location. The hosting, gateway logging and privacy-by-default listing claims are adjacent features and do not deliver residency choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
